When a group stays alone and no relay is set, the pairing card now says that first. Without a relay, two instances find each other only through multicast on the local network, and Docker's default bridge network blocks it, so a missing relay is the more likely cause than a second group.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Still alone without a relay points at the relay first.** The hint opened with "Created a phrase on both instances?", which sent people off to leave and rejoin a group that was fine ([#270](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/bombvault/issues/270)). It now leads with the missing relay, its (i) explains why instances in Docker's bridge network can't find each other on their own, and a Project relay button next to it turns the relay on right there.

## Upgrading

- Nothing to do.
